# Wondrr

> Wondrr is a travel marketplace where solo travellers and groups discover and book
> fixed-departure group trips from India's top verified travel brands — all on one
> platform. Browse curated treks, road trips, and adventures across India, compare
> dates and prices, and book directly with vetted hosts.

Wondrr (https://wondrr.in) operates in India (en-IN). It aggregates group trips from
independent, verified travel hosts and lets travellers book safe group adventures with
like-minded people.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://wondrr.in/): Discover group trips and fixed departures.
- [All trips](https://wondrr.in/trips): Browse every available group trip.
- [About Wondrr](https://wondrr.in/about): Who we are and how the marketplace works.
- [How we work](https://wondrr.in/how-we-work): How booking and verified hosts work.
- [Partner with us](https://wondrr.in/partner-with-us): For travel brands and hosts.
- [Booking policy](https://wondrr.in/booking-policy): Terms, cancellation, and refunds.

## Content

- Trip pages live at https://wondrr.in/trip/<slug> and include itinerary, inclusions,
  dates, prices (INR), host details, and traveller reviews.
- Verified host profiles live at https://wondrr.in/<host-username>.
- The full URL inventory is in the sitemap: https://wondrr.in/sitemap.xml

## Notes

- All hosts on Wondrr are verified travel brands.
- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR). Bookings are made directly on the platform.
